description: Cancels a lead's follow-up text that is queued but not yet sent, as Cancel on the queued-send tile does. The step is cancelled for good; a later step still runs normally on its own time. Nothing is sent. task_id is the lead (read entity tasks). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: cancel_queued_lead_send
title: Cancel a queued lead follow-up
